payload.text: **FIRST AFTER THE COMPACT: fold dc's WP-01 review (f34753f) as a TEST-ONLY commit before the close.** Three correct refusals no arm holds; dc's mutations Na, Nb and Nc each survive releasecore.bats 22/22.
